title.why: Two titles from J-AISI's own English covers: 'Guide to Evaluation Perspectives on AI Safety' and 'Guide to Red Teaming Methodology on AI Safety'; the title joins both with a semicolon.

original_title.why: Covers read AI セーフティに関する評価観点ガイド and AI セーフティに関する レッドチーミング手法ガイド (cover text layer has spaces after 'AI' only). Record text matches without those spaces, the normal way of writing them.

issuing_body.why: Covers name AI セーフティ・インスティテュート / Japan AI Safety Institute.

date_published.why: Outputs list: evaluation guide 2024年9月18日, red teaming guide 2024年9月25日; the record takes the earlier; the later is in notes.

date_last_updated.why: Release page: 評価観点ガイド (第1.20版) 2026年7月7日公表.

status.why: Release page announces the updated v1.20; a search found no later version of either guide.

legal_force.why: Guides offered as a reference for developers and providers (参照できる基本的な考え方), no binding force.

english_version.why: kind 'government translation' by J-AISI; URL https://aisi.go.jp/assets/pdf/ai_safety_eval_v1.10_en.pdf is a stored source (sha256 1f6ab8ed...). It is v1.10 of the evaluation guide only and is marked 'Please refer to the original text for accuracy'; the verification note states that no v1.20 English exists. A reader might want kind 'government translation (v1.10 only)', but the note covers it.

summary.why: Checked below; every named perspective and the 15 steps exist in the Japanese text.

summary_claims.claim: Evaluation guide perspectives include control of toxic output, fairness and inclusion, privacy protection, ensuring security, robustness and verifiability
summary_claims.locator: table of contents page 2 of v1.20 (Japanese), sections 3.1, 3.3, 3.5, 3.6, 3.8, 3.10
summary_claims.translation: 3.1 有害情報の出力制御 'control of harmful-information output' (J-AISI's English: Control of Toxic Output); 3.3 公平性と包摂性 'fairness and inclusiveness'; 3.5 プライバシー保護 'privacy protection'; 3.6 セキュリティ確保 'ensuring security'; 3.8 ロバスト性 'robustness'; 3.10 検証可能性 'verifiability'.

summary_claims.claim: Version 1.20 adds 'observation and control' for AI agent systems
summary_claims.locator: section 3.11 観測と制御(AI エージェントシステム), page 35; header on release page 'updated and expanded perspectives and example items'
summary_claims.translation: 3.11 'Observation and control (AI agent systems)'; the text explains it in two viewpoints, observation and control (観測及び制御の 2 つの視点).

summary_claims.claim: Red teaming guide covers evaluating risk countermeasures of LLM systems from an attacker's perspective, from attack methods and roles to a 15-step process
summary_claims.locator: red teaming guide v1.10 section 1.1 and table of contents (STEP 1 to STEP 15; chapters 3 attack methods, 4 実施体制と役割)
summary_claims.translation: '...the countermeasures applied to risks are evaluated from the viewpoint of an attacker (a person who intends to misuse or destroy the AI system)'; chapter 3 'Representative attack methods against LLM systems', chapter 4 'Implementation structure and roles'.

scope.note: Government safety institute's technical guidance on AI safety evaluation and red teaming.

note: The new summary is accurate against the Japanese guides: the listed perspectives, the v1.20 addition of observation and control for AI agents, the attacker viewpoint, attack methods, roles and the 15 STEPs all appear in the stored texts. Titles and dates match the covers and J-AISI's outputs list. The English version is the stored v1.10 translation of the evaluation guide only, which the verification note says. A search found no newer version. A search hit (aisi.go.jp/output/output_information/251031/) was not opened; it is probably an unrelated release.
